description: Dependency-update cadence of chapter 13 §13.3.8 (WI-0.007): weekly grouped PRs for GitHub Actions SHAs, Gradle/AGP/Kotlin/AndroidX, Python requirements, pre-commit hook revisions and the vcpkg baseline. Qt, the NDK, compileSdk/targetSdk, the macOS deployment target and the third_party/VERSIONS.md decoder pins are never updated automatically.
